ideas.title: Uncovering the Extent of Minnesota Fraud Schemes
ideas.description: Investigate the recent arrests and accusations related to fraud schemes in Minnesota, and explore the possibility of a larger network of individuals involved.
questions: Who else is involved in these fraud schemes?
How much money has been lost to these schemes?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme, and could lead to further investigations and arrests.
